title: A Mountain Adventure
description: Minh and An climb a mountain with their father.
instructions: Read about the mountain adventure. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: ⛰️ Last August, Minh and his sister An went camping in the mountains with their father. They had never climbed a mountain before, so they were a little nervous. Dad said, 'Don't worry. We will go slowly and take lots of rests.'

They started walking at seven o'clock in the morning. The path went through a forest, where the trees were so tall that the sun could hardly get through. They heard birds singing and saw a small deer drinking water from a stream.

After three hours, it became colder and windy. An put on her warm jacket, but Minh had left his at the camp! Dad gave him his scarf and hat. 'You should always check your bag before a long walk,' he said.

At noon, they sat on a big rock and ate their lunch: sandwiches, apples and boiled eggs. A friendly mountain guide called Mr Hung walked past, and he told them about the weather. 'If you want to reach the top before dark, you should leave now,' he said.

The last part of the walk was the hardest. The path was steep and covered in stones, and Minh's legs were tired. An held his hand and said, 'We are nearly there!' After one more hour, they reached the top.
The view was incredible. They could see green valleys, a blue lake and clouds below their feet. It felt like standing in the sky. Dad took a photo of the three of them, and they shouted happily.

That night, they slept in a small tent and looked at the stars, which were brighter than in the city. Minh said, 'This is the best adventure of my life.' In the morning, they walked down, and next year they are going to climb a higher mountain.
